dʰéh₁yēte is SBJV.2PL; 'if they (the young ones, h₁íh₂ n.pl.) suckle' needs 3rd person (3sg with neuter plural subject dʰéh₁yēti, as kénketi/péh₃eti in the same record, or 3pl)
ḱósyeh₂i nókʷtn̥s: nókʷtn̥s is ACC.PL 'nights' beside fem. LOC.SG ḱósyeh₂i; 'this night' needs LOC.SG nékʷti (as in other records)
swóybʰos is DAT/ABL.PL of reflexive swós and agrees with nothing ('give me my wage' — misdʰóm is acc.sg); should be moy misdʰóm alone (or acc.sg)
Hrumptā́m is 3DU (secondary -tām) with singular subject uksḗn 'the bull has broken'; needs 3SG
sweh₂dúh₁ is NOM/ACC.DU (or INS.SG); predicate of neuter singular h₂mélǵos 'milk is sweet' needs NOM.SG.N sweh₂dú
